name: OnePlus TV (C00, Cebu, MediaTek m7632), India
warnings: Left alone and never launched: the factory apps (com.heytap.optvfactory, com.oneplus.tv.factory). setupwraith does not claim HOME here.

With it disabled, dumpsys hdmi_control still detects the connected device (e.g. a PlayStation 5 on HDMI 3), but com.heytap.tv.livetv leaves mainSessionToken null and times out after 3 seconds with "No Signal, please check the connection of input source." (#321).
